title: The Demon-Haunted World
author: Carl Sagan
summary: Carl Sagan defends scientific skepticism, examining UFO claims, faith healing and witch hunts to show how to test ideas and why that habit protects a free society.
readIf: you want a toolkit for spotting bad arguments, written with warmth.
skipIf: you want new science news, as many examples are from the 1990s.
